verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents access to the Stripe API, and Terminal's in-person payments are managed alongside online payments in Stripe, so an agent has a documented path to payment data. Payouts and webhook event delivery are documented too. However, nothing in the evidence shows API endpoints for listing transactions or payouts, nor any reconciliation or ledger-export feature, so reconciling daily takings would have to be built by the user. Missing for 10: documented API retrieval of transactions/balance transactions and payouts, payout-to-transaction reconciliation reports, ledger/accounting export, hands-on corroboration of an agent reconciliation workflow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull transactions and payouts via API and reconcile daily takings into my ledger

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
you can accept in-person payments and manage them alongside your online payments in Stripe
Stripe sends funds from your available balance to your bank account as payouts.
After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events occur.
